notes.title: The 'RISE MUSE ' will be officially released on December 11, 2024
notes.content:
Dear player friends:

    The 'RISE MUSE' will officially meet everyone on December 11, 2024!

    I hope players can immerse themselves in a wonderful and challenging gaming world. On the Muse 

Continent, you will engage in intellectual battles with the most dangerous enemies Brave, unlock the seal 

of the male god, defeat the goddess, and restore world order. This game features a unique three deck 

combat mechanism, contract system, and free deck construction, And the exciting storyline will bring you 

a brand new gaming experience. And there are unique goddess character settings, each goddess has a 

distinct personality The ever-changing skills await players to use their wits to defeat them and uncover 

their mysteries.

    On December 11, 2024, this important day is approaching. We sincerely invite players to join our 

gaming world and embark on this journey together An exciting adventure journey. Transform into the 

protagonist and write your own game story. Let's look forward to the launch of the game together and 

fully immerse ourselves in the world of gaming.


    Are you ready? every body、 let's go !!!

notes.title: Announcement of Extension of The Contract of 《rise&muse》
notes.content:
Announcement on the Delay of the Release of 《rise&muse》
Hello, everyone!
We are extremely grateful for your anticipation and support for "《rise&muse》". The game, which we originally planned to launch in the near future, needs to be postponed for the following reasons:
Recently, during the game development and testing process, we discovered some crucial technical issues. These issues require more time and energy to be resolved to ensure the quality and stability of the game. In order to ensure that players can enjoy the best gaming experience, we have decided to postpone the release time.
We are fully aware that this delay will cause inconvenience to you all, and we sincerely apologize for it. Meanwhile, we promise that we will go all out to solve the relevant problems as soon as possible and announce the new release time as soon as we can.
We deeply understand that the trust and support from players are our greatest motivation. We will continue to work hard to bring you even higher-quality game content. Please rest assured to follow our official announcements. We will inform you of the latest release information in a timely manner.
Thank you again for your understanding and support! Let's work together to create a wonderful future for "《rise&muse》"!
The Development Team of "《rise&muse》"

notes.title: Live stream will be held on October 14 from 22:00(GMT+8)
notes.content:
Dear friends, are you ready to embrace the enchantment of beautiful girls? We will be hosting an exciting live stream on October 19, and we can't wait for you to join us!

During the live stream, we'll showcase the charm of the Contract Continent! We hope you'll add our new products to your wish list and follow us! Your support is our greatest motivation to move forward!

Don't forget to bring your friends along to enjoy this feast of beautiful girls together! Let's embark on a new adventure during the live stream!

Looking forward to seeing you in the stream!
